hash_method: SHA256 of exact raw file bytes captured at review completion; all captured files checked again before evidence write. Hash inclusion does not imply full-file audit for supporting files.
scope: Complete digest-before-parse trust helper and pinned expected digest
Owned archive snapshot construction, caller-index revalidation, transactional replacement, fallible reserve paths, read-only mutators and forged-handle bounds
Complete mounted system publication/preflight/cleanup, routing, canonical paths, retained mountpoint mutation denial and lifetime pinning

static_checks.result: Bounded immutable copy is verified against kernel policy before archive construction/publication; every supplied byte is hashed.
Public indexes are reparsed and compared before any caller-controlled slicing; construction stages separately and commits only after success.

Fallible preflight returns owned staged bindings; unpublished archive buffers are released on failure; namespace publication is infallible after staging; routed mutations deny system writes, including old mountpoint IDs.

Reserved descriptor word is ignored without weakening meaningful bounds/overlap checks; accepted module ranges stay reserved, rounded and identity-checked; PageMap borrow ends before fallible copy allocation.

Injection preserves EAX and redirects/readbacks EBX; ordered exact outcome sequence rejects mismatched refusal classes; cleanup and unchanged full-media hash participate in PASS; parent validates explicit complete unique matrix and invocation-owned children.
Current diff chunks GDB writes with per-chunk readback; RAMFS cleanup now compares against captured preexisting root listing, allowing legitimate /system without dropping cleanup equality.

nonblocking_observations.detail: Optional stronger guest oracle: reread both trusted files after all six rejected mutation commands. Current guest code rechecks listing but not final file contents; direct archive/routing code denies writes and supporting host tests cover unchanged contents, so no demonstrated implementation blocker.

Malformed/truncated guest cases deliberately require DigestMismatch, not the structural-parser rejection branch. Correctly authenticated malformed inputs are covered by host trust tests, not by this production-pinned guest matrix. Keep those claims distinct.

limits: Read-only static review only: no QEMU, builds, cargo tests, Python unittest suites, Git-index changes, commits or external side effects.
Full acceptance is owned by another agent and was not certified or evaluated by this review; this verdict is not release approval.
Supporting paging/inventory review is limited to module-copy provenance, pins, mapping and reserved-word integration, not a general unsafe/allocator/frame audit.
No measured runtime heap/stack high-water claim; emitted capacity bound excludes allocator overhead and stack headroom.
No hardware secure boot or hostile-firmware isolation is supplied; kernel/loader backing and single-owner ring-0 assumptions remain.
